title: Claude CLI
purpose: Lets the AI Layer ask Claude, using your own Claude login.
description: Lets the AI Layer ask Claude to answer general questions and summarise text. It uses a Claude login you set up inside this add-on, so no separate key is needed. It stops when the weekly or daily limit is reached, and removes personal details from the text first. It has no access to Home Assistant.
navigation: Stops at the weekly and daily limits
